blocks.html:
In our commitment to providing a seamless experience for both our consultants and our clients, we are transitioning to Zoho Bookings as our primary scheduling tool. This transition isn't just about moving to a new software; it's about empowering you to own your schedule while maintaining the professional, high-touch brand standards of OneAccord. By centralizing our bookings, we eliminate the back-and-forth of "calendar tag," ensuring that your first touchpoint with a potential client is effortless, organized, and professional.

This training is designed to give you full control over your personal availability. You will learn how to sync your Outlook calendar to prevent double-bookings, integrate Microsoft Teams for automatic meeting links, and customize your own "breathing room" through buffer times and specific working hours. Ultimately, these tools are here to protect your time and allow you to focus on delivering high-value insights to your clients rather than managing administrative logistics.

1. Personalizing Your Consultant Profile

Goal: Ensure your booking page looks professional and reflects your individual brand.

  • Log in to Zoho Bookings.
  • Click on Consultants in the left-hand menu.
  • Find your name and open your profile. You'll see tabs across the top: Profile, Availability, Assigned Consultations, and Integrations.
  • Upload your Profile Picture. Use a professional headshot — this is the first thing clients see.
  • Write your Bio. Briefly explain your expertise (1–2 sentences). This builds trust before the client even clicks a time slot.
  • Verify your Booking URL. It should follow the format bookings.oneaccord.co/<yourname>.

2. Syncing Your Outlook Calendar & Teams

Goal: Prevent double-bookings and automate your meeting links.

  • In your profile, click on the Integrations tab.
  • Find Office 365 / Outlook Calendar and click Configure. Follow the prompts to sign in.
  • Ensure "Check for Conflicts" is turned ON for your primary work calendar.
  • Find Microsoft Teams in the Video Conferencing section and click Authorize. This ensures every booking automatically generates a Teams link.
  • If you have other calendars that need to be checked for conflicts, link them here too — this is also where you can double-check that everything is syncing accurately.

3. Setting Your Working Hours & Breaks

Goal: Control exactly when you are available for meetings.

  • In your profile, go to the Availability tab.
  • Select "Customize working hours for this staff."
  • Set your start and end times for each day.
  • Add Breaks. If you want a daily lunch hour or a "no-meeting" block, add it here.
  • Time Zone Check. Ensure your time zone is set correctly to avoid confusion with remote clients.

blocks.html:
4. Understanding Your Service Templates

Goal: Review your assigned meeting types and the built-in buffer.

  • You are currently assigned to two standard templates: the 30-minute and 60-minute appointment. These are the two OneAccord offers by default — other durations exist in the system for exceptions but aren't meant to be offered on your booking page day-to-day.
  • The 15-Minute Buffer: To ensure you have time for note-taking or preparation, both meeting types include a 15-minute buffer added to the end of the appointment.
  • Review your services list in your profile to ensure both options are active. If you notice a template is missing, please contact the Admin.
  • Note: you do not need to set the buffer manually — the system automatically protects this time on your calendar.

blocks.html:
5. Final Review & Live Link Test

Goal: Ensure the client experience is perfect.

  • Copy your Individual Booking URL from your profile (bookings.oneaccord.co/<yourname>).
  • Open the link in an "Incognito" or "Private" browser window to see what the client sees.
  • The Audit Checklist: Is your photo visible? Are the 30 and 60-minute options appearing? Does the availability match your Outlook "Free" time?
  • Once confirmed, add this link to your Outlook Email Signature.

The Share button on your profile gives you a few handy extras beyond the plain link: a QR code you can share so someone can open your booking page instantly on their phone, a shortened URL, a one-time-use link, and an option to embed your booking page as a widget elsewhere. Worth exploring if you're handing out your booking link in person or embedding it somewhere other than your email signature.
